title: Google announces the Agent Payments Protocol with signed Intent and Cart mandates
summary: On 16 September 2025 Google announced the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), an open protocol developed with more than 60 organizations for agent-led payments that can be used as an extension of the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). AP2 uses tamper-proof, cryptographically signed Mandates backed by verifiable credentials: an Intent Mandate records the user's request and, for delegated tasks, conditions such as price limits and timing, a Cart Mandate signed on user approval fixes the exact items and price, and the chain from intent to cart to payment forms a non-repudiable audit trail for authorization, authenticity and accountability.
